prompts.showerFirst:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent pixel art game prop, one static shower-head sprite.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference only: match its softly colored pixel art, stepped pixel outlines, restrained highlights, soft gray-purple edging, and upper-left light. Do not draw the sponge. Input image 2 is a COLOR reference only for matching cool pale blue-gray shading.
Subject: a small rounded handheld shower head, complete circular spray face attached to a short handle. The spray face sits toward the upper-left, the short handle extends to the upper-right, so the spray face points diagonally downward and slightly left. Show a visible downward facing oval spray face with simple readable holes. Pale desaturated blue-gray body, cream highlights, muted gray-purple outlines. Friendly compact proportions with simple depth, no exaggerated realism. Fixed clean side / three quarter view suitable above a pet. Single sprite centered with generous transparent margin, entire outline visible.
Constraints: genuinely transparent Alpha PNG. Only the shower head and short handle; NO water, NO hose, NO hand, NO pet, NO sponge, NO bubbles, NO background, floor, shadow, text, numbers, borders or grid. Crisp pixel steps, no blur.
prompts.showerFix:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: attached shower head sprite. Correct two defects: remove ALL broad purple glow and translucent haze around the sprite, leaving a hard stepped pixel-art silhouette against full alpha transparency. Re-angle only the spray head so its spray face points downward and slightly left; it must be seen as a noticeably foreshortened shallow oval underside, not a large round face looking toward viewer. Keep the same short handle toward upper-right, pale blue-gray body, cream highlights, muted gray-purple thin outline, compact rounded prop, and upper-left light. Preserve simple stylized pixel-art material. Complete entire sprite in generous transparent margin. Absolutely no glow, blur, ambient shadow, water, hose, hand, background, text, grid, other objects. Actual transparent Alpha PNG.
prompts.showerFinal:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create one standalone handheld shower head game sprite on actual fully transparent alpha background. Match the reference image's soft pastel pixel art style and upper-left light, but draw ONLY a shower head. Compact rounded circular head with a visible foreshortened oval underside facing down-left, short handle extending up-right. A dozen simple readable spray holes. Pale blue-gray solid body, cream highlights, thin muted gray-purple pixel outline. All color is restricted inside the hard clean stepped sprite silhouette. Surrounding pixels must be completely transparent. NO GLOW, NO HALO, NO HAZE, NO BLUR, NO SHADOW of any kind. No water, hose, hand, pet, sponge, bubbles, extra objects, labels or grid. Center the entire prop within generous transparent padding. Small friendly game item, simple clean materials, crisp pixel clusters.
prompts.waterFirst:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game VFX animation sprite sheet, exactly SIX separate shower-water frames, ordered left to right in top row then bottom row, precisely 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells. No lines or labels.
Reference is for softly colored pixel-art style and pale blue-white cool effect palette ONLY. Do not draw foam or any objects from reference.
Subject in EACH cell: a gentle shower spray of several separated slender branching water lines with transparent gaps, aimed downward and slightly left. It emerges from the SAME small source position at top center in EVERY cell. The main fall direction runs from upper center to lower-left-center. All six frames have the same source, viewing angle, length and fan angle. Full sprite visible with transparent padding. Water should stay mostly open and airy, no solid waterfall block. Soft pale blue short dashes and white highlights, restrained blue-gray pixel edges; crisp stepped pixel clusters with no blur or surrounding glow.
Frame 1: water starting, only a few thin sparse dashed streams.
Frame 2: stable flow begins, more slender streams and light flecks.
Frame 3: same stable shower geometry as 2, the short dashes/highlights have traveled downward along stream directions.
Frame 4: same stable geometry, dashes move further down.
Frame 5: same stable geometry, dashes complete a loop so it naturally reconnects to frame 2.
Frame 6: water stopping, streams have broken into sparse disconnected short segments.
Keep source position and drawn scale identical across six cells, never independently enlarge frames to fit. Preserve transparent space between and around all streams. Actual transparent alpha PNG. NO shower head, NO hose, NO pet, NO bubbles, NO foam, NO ground, NO puddle, NO shadows/glow, NO text, NO numbers or borders.
prompts.waterFinal:
Use case: stylized-concept
Draw an atlas of six game animation sprites: water from a gentle shower. Exactly THREE columns and TWO rows, six equal square cells, ordered row-major, NO grids or labels. Use reference only for soft colored pixel art, crisp stepped shapes, restrained palette. NO shower head from reference.
In every cell, several thin disconnected pale blue water lines fan downward and slightly LEFT from one identical top-center source. Streams have generous fully transparent gaps. Sparse blue-white highlights travel downward. Pixel art short dashes, no smooth blur. Full spray fits inside each cell, fixed source, fixed angle, fixed drawn scale and length. Frame 1 opening: sparse few thin water lines. Frames 2,3,4,5 stable flow: same fan shape, with short water dashes and highlights visibly progressing downwards, 5 loops to 2. Frame 6 closing: streams break into sparse detached short segments.
Palette: pale blue lines with blue-white highlights and tiny cool gray-blue pixel edges. Every pixel OUTSIDE each individual thin water line or individual droplet is FULLY TRANSPARENT. Transparent holes between streams are critical. DO NOT add any mist, fog, halo, glow, shadow, tinted area, luminous air, broad gradient or background. Water lines only, on actual Alpha transparent PNG. NO pet, prop, head, hose, sponge, foam, bubbles, floor, puddle, text or numbers. Enough empty transparent padding to prevent clipping.
